About Me

Driven by Curiosity

Aspiring IT professional committed to building secure, impactful technology through continuous learning and hands-on experience.

My journey into technology started with a simple question: how do things work? That curiosity led me to pursue BS Information Technology at the Polytechnic University of the Philippines, where I've been building a strong foundation in systems, networking, and cybersecurity.

I'm currently serving as an intern in the Management Information Systems (MIS) department at American Technologies Inc. in Mandaluyong City — gaining real-world exposure to enterprise IT operations and systems management.

Outside of tech, I play badminton for discipline, ride motorcycles for exploration, and compete in strategic video games to sharpen analytical thinking.

JT Accounting System

The system provides an intuitive interface for managing financial records, tracking transactions, and generating accounting reports — replacing manual bookkeeping with a centralized digital solution.

Key features include transaction management, financial reporting, account ledgers, and a clean dashboard for monitoring the financial state of an organization. Built with a focus on usability for non-technical users.
